domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 对桥梁响应具有主要贡献的频率。
usage_overview: 在列车作用下的桥梁动力分析中，指列车周期性通过所产生、对桥梁响应有显著贡献的激励频率，用于考察周期性激励对桥梁动力响应的影响。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P093.title: Influence of dominant frequencies and their higher harmonics on the dynamic responses of railway bridge subjected to high-speed trains
P093.authors: NK Kedia, C Ngamkhanong, Y Singh, L Xu
P093.label: Kedia等（2025）

complete_examples.text: The moving train load gives rise to driving and dominant frequencies, which can resonate with the natural frequencies of the bridge, poten tially leading to amplified vibrations and structural damage, reducing the serviceability of the bridge and train [5,6].

The results show that the occurrence of specific harmonic numbers of dominant frequencies depends on train speed and the fundamental time period of railway bridges, and a nonlinear relationship exists between harmonic number, train speed and fundamental time period of bridges.
